'''Jar'ga''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]] owner. Jar'ga the Hutt pioneered the development of [[Holo-sabacc/Legends|Holo-Sabacc]], a variation of the card game [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] that was played entirely through [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] without physical cards.<ref name="Codex" />

Jar'ga first commissioned Holo-Sabacc in a casino on<ref name="Codex" /> the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in order to combat longtime rampant cheating in both amateur and professional sabacc games, as he did not tolerate such profit-gouging like his fellow casino owners. Jar'ga's invention quickly became popular across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and<ref name="Codex" /> by [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|4.3}} As the Codex entry Holo-Sabacc, which mentions Jar'ga, was added with Game Update 4.3, its associated events can be placed by that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]] as well.</ref> every casino in known [[Realspace/Legends|space]] had installed at least one Holo-Sabacc table. [[Slicer/Legends|Slicers]], however, quickly adapted, stacking holo-decks and altering card algorithms. The sliced Holo-Sabacc systems were obtainable on every major [[Planet/Legends|world's]] [[Black market/Legends|black market]]. Jar'ga himself hid a sliced Holo-Sabacc table in his casino stacked in the dealer's favor.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jar'ga was mentioned in the Codex entry for Holo-Sabacc in the [[2015]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]].<ref name="Codex" />
